name: Dr. Harshita Kaushik
title: Assistant Professor & Academic Researcher

phd.topic: Impact of Artificial Intelligence and Conversational Interfaces on E-Commerce companies- An evaluation of customer’s engagement in Bengaluru city

heroStatement: Researching how artificial intelligence and conversational interfaces change customer engagement in digital commerce.
summary: Academician and management educator passionate about teaching, student development, and meaningful learning experiences. Currently Assistant Professor at Srinivas University, focusing on nurturing students' academic and personal growth. With a Ph.D. in Management from Tumkur University and an MBA from Banaras Hindu University, her research spans artificial intelligence, conversational commerce, consumer behavior, and targeted marketing.
